required_boundaries: The 40 pairs are unique exact source-position and source-annotation locator matches. They are neither an upstream nor a physical atom map.
Ten Step 2 depiction nodes lack Step 3 locators. Their absence is missing evidence and is never interpreted as atom deletion.
Step 2 draws water as explicit H-O-H; Step 3 redraws a source-labeled water fragment as H-O. No physical water or hydrogen correspondence is established.
All six edits have valid Step 2 source-graph preconditions and exact Step 2 arrow bindings. Only three retained-core charge/bond-order edits have after-graph verification.
Generic CHEBI:90799 labels and R tokens do not establish an exact physical peptide, canonical participant correspondence or net-reaction atom map.
Neither panel contains bondStereo or bond-convention rows. No stereochemical assignment or preservation is asserted.
